newsitem.title: UK: Mercury extends losses trading statment.
newsitem.headline: Mercury extends losses trading statment.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Group Plc extended early losses and were among the biggest losers on the FTSE 100 at midday on Thursday after the group issued a cautious trading statement.
By 1104 GMT, the shares were down 65-1/2p, or 4.5 percent, to 1376.
Earlier, Mercury said its profit growth may not be sustainable in the future, igniting the decline in the shares..
